lib/cn.ts.name: Class name merge
lib/cn.ts.description: Re-exports tailwind-merge as cn so components combine Tailwind class lists without conflicting utilities.

lib/layout.shared.tsx.name: Shared navbar options
lib/layout.shared.tsx.description: Builds the Fumadocs BaseLayoutProps every layout spreads: the logo title and the top navbar links to each section landing page.

lib/merge-refs.ts.name: Ref merging
lib/merge-refs.ts.description: Returns one callback ref that hands the element to several React refs, callback or object.

lib/og.tsx.name: Social card renderer
lib/og.tsx.description: Renders the single 1200x630 Open Graph card with literal colours Satori can resolve, shared by the docs and home image routes.

lib/posthog.ts.name: Page feedback action
lib/posthog.ts.description: Server action that re-validates a page rating and posts it to PostHog as an anonymous docs_feedback event; never throws.
